response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) as total FROM trans) SELECT account_id, region, total_amount, transaction_count, CAST(total_amount AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM grand_total) as fraction FROM account_totals ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
